name: Temple Street, Southern End
desc1: This wide, litter-cluttered street is paved with broken and chipped
desc2: flagstones. Tall, rickety buildings tower above on either side of the
desc3: street, their barred and curtained windows disquietingly watchful. The
desc4: end of this street is lined with shops-- a tavern to the west,
desc5: sporting liquor and brawls, a trainer to the east, and a tall, dark
desc6: temple to the south, a large red eye emblazoned on its door. The
desc7: street continues off to the north here.
